home.architectureIntro: Traditional credit assessment models rely strictly on archaic FICO indices, penalizing small business owners and contractors. Degital introduces custom, safety-compliant mathematical modeling to dynamically verify true repayment strength in real-time.
home.cashflowDesc: We read ledger stability factors, consistent deposits, and recurrent subscriptions rather than static scoring matrices.
home.fairLendingDesc: Explicit mitigation algorithms prevent demographic bias, keeping evaluations strictly focused on financial numbers and true cash safety.
home.fraudDesc: Integrated pattern recognizers compare metadata structures against hundreds of tampering behaviors automatically.
home.auditTrailIntro: Our model maps thousands of variables. Here is how a standard verification log translates for an applicant with irregular freelancing cashflows:
home.featureNeuralDesc: Our proprietary multi-layer neural network looks beyond legacy credit scores to assess alternative cashflow habits instantly.
home.featureRapidDesc: Complete our simplified digital criteria questionnaire and receive an instant, accurate underwriting pre-approval output.
home.featureOcrDesc: Upload your income proofs and KYC documents through an encrypted channel; our compliance team reviews and verifies each one before it factors into your application.
home.whyChooseDesc: By taking advantage of deep-learning algorithms, we restructure the traditional friction points of personal and commercial borrowing, bringing unmatched speed, accessibility, and transparency.
home.benefitEnhancedApprovalDesc: Alternative scoring parameters recognize stable income streams traditional systems overlook, raising baseline approvals by 27%.
home.benefitAprDesc: Instead of strict rigid tiering, our reinforcement engine computes custom rates aligned exactly to your debt-to-income bandwidth.
home.benefitPrivacyDesc: All submitted KYC assets are dynamically redacted during analysis, securing absolute confidentiality across databases.
home.benefitIntegrationDesc: Compatible with standard bank ledger configurations, simplifying manual loan officer audits with robust metadata transparency.
home.ctaSubtitle: Take our 5-minute digital-eligibility quiz to preview risk tiers, interest rates, and customized repayment schedules designed for you. No credit score drop guaranteed.

about.objectivesTitle: The Three Core Pillars of Degital
about.pageSubtitle: Learn more about the project goals, core mathematical objectives, technological stack, and researchers behind this modern underwriting SaaS simulator.
about.genesisPara1: The traditional financial apparatus evaluates risk using methods created in the mid-20th century. Standard credit reports represent historical payments but fail to capture real-time financial trajectory or asset stability.
about.genesisPara2: Degital AI Loan System is an academic simulation built to showcase the feasibility of decentralized, automated credit assessments. By integrating secure document handling and alternative cashflow modeling, Degital predicts debt-to-income sustainability in real-time, removing biases and streamlining officer review queues.
about.blueprintQuote: "Our simulation bridges user-submitted data with algorithmic rate-setting, proving that digital automation can slash application assessment latencies from weeks to under five seconds safely."
about.objectiveAccuracyDesc: Move past static 3-digit legacy scores by predicting default probability with multiple concurrent data variables.
about.objectiveAccessDesc: Establish alternative paths to credit for self-employed individuals, creators, and micro-entrepreneurs.
about.objectivePrivacyDesc: Verify financial files dynamically through client-redacted server pipelines, maintaining strict bank compliance.
about.stackFrontend2: Tailwind CSS Utility architecture with custom banking theme
about.stackFrontend3: Lucide React clean design svg iconography
about.stackFrontend4: Framer Motion / Motion engine for fluid transitions
about.stackAi1: Deep reinforcement neural networks for rate optimization
about.stackAi2: Encrypted document storage with staff-reviewed verification
about.stackAi3: Metadata verification & document tamper detection scoring
about.stackAi4: Large language model (LLM) legal text translation pipelines
about.stackData3: Mock backend safety logs displaying raw underwriting telemetry
about.stackData4: Compliance sandboxing mapped for academic demonstration
about.teamBio1: Former MIT AI Lab lead developer. Evelyn designs our underlying credit risk scoring neural networks and automated evaluation engines.
about.teamBio2: Over 15 years securing banking applications. Marcus ensures our document handling and predictive analysis architectures remain military-grade secure.
about.teamBio3: Experienced quantitative analyst. Siddharth structures our loan profiles, mathematical models, and predictive eligibility formulas.

servicesPage.pageSubtitle: A complete look at what you can do here — apply for a loan, exchange currency, and get AI-assisted guidance along the way.
servicesPage.loanProductsDesc: Six loan types to choose from — Personal, Housing, Vehicle Leasing, Education, Business, and Pawning — each with clear rates and terms shown upfront.
servicesPage.riskAssessmentDesc: We assess every application using your income, employment, and credit history to give you a clear Low, Medium, or High risk result in seconds.
servicesPage.smartRecommendationsDesc: Based on your risk result, we recommend a loan amount, type, and repayment plan sized to what you can comfortably afford.
servicesPage.aiExplanationDesc: Every risk result comes with a short, easy-to-understand explanation of the main factors behind it — in English, Sinhala, or Tamil.
servicesPage.fxExchangeDesc: Get a live quote, see your transaction limits and any document requirements upfront, then submit and track your request online. Once approved, print a settlement slip to complete it at a branch.
servicesPage.currencyRatesDesc: Real-time buy/sell exchange rates, historical rate charts, and a volatility outlook — always clearly marked as context, never a price prediction.
servicesPage.emiCalculatorDesc: Estimate your monthly loan installment instantly — no sign-in needed.
servicesPage.eligibilityDesc: Get a quick sense of your loan eligibility. Sign in for a full, live assessment.
servicesPage.supportDesc: Message our team directly from your account and track every reply in one place.
servicesPage.multilingualDesc: Use the entire site in English, Sinhala, or Tamil — switch anytime from the navigation bar.
servicesPage.complianceBody: This page describes the services available in this application, built as an academic project. No real personal or financial data is processed — every result shown is for demonstration purposes only.
